entry_state: The complete implementation chapter preserves typed source occurrences, transformed values, context, immutable views and one owner for each mutation. It ends with a concrete but unadmitted importer selection. The reader next needs distinct evidence for implementation correctness, accounting validity and empirical usefulness.
findings: 349–351: Engineering, accounting and forecast evidence remain separate. T01–T18 include balanced-but-wrong counterexamples,5/7 financing responses, unresolved solver outcomes and preserved conditional laws. External ledgers and calculators are comparators only on matched supported tasks.

351–352: Real reconstruction tests compatibility rather than recovery of an unknowable true journal. DSL evaluation uses the sameIR and competent typed-library baseline; unfavorable evidence can narrow the notation without discarding the representation.

352–353: Forecast comparison declares common information and targets, a baseline ladder, dependent-data uncertainty and separate promotion/experiment-invalidity conditions. No forecast run or new default is claimed.

353–354: Historical availability remains unresolved where unsupported; a March release cannot support an entirely future preceding-January annual target. E1 requires independent located labels and preserves unresolved coverage. E2 tests exact finite soundness/completeness and treats timeout as incomplete. E3 begins with corporate operating cash flow and first-release outcomes.
Six rendered pages read; the target-protocol section continues. No additional reader defect confirmed.
